verdict.rationale:
Postman offers a documented API (postman-docs-5) and CLI (postman-docs-19, postman-docs-32) that let teams programmatically manage collections/environments and run them from CI/CD pipelines, which is a form of APIOps for test/mock assets, and it has a Fabric Gateway for registering MCP servers (postman-docs-7). However there is no evidence of declarative config for actual API-gateway infrastructure (routing, rate-limits, traffic policies) or a GitOps controller/IaC provider that syncs gateway state from CI — the CI/CD integration shown is limited to running/testing collections, not managing gateway traffic as code.

missing for 10: declarative gateway/traffic config format, IaC/GitOps controller or Terraform-style provider, evidence of syncing gateway state (not just tests) from CI pipelines.
